name: Broodlord Lashlayer
source: [core: vmangos] vmangos gives his melee 2,746 to 3,640 a 2.0 s swing before armor (vmangos core (github.com/vmangos/core, db_latest db-4641790): creature_template, spell_template, the boss script, damage_multiplier 25), which makes Mortal Strike (24573: 500% weapon damage and 50% less healing taken for 5 s, the Classic Era client's spell data) 6,000 to 7,900 on a 56% armor tank before any crit. Players saw far less: warcraft.wiki.gg's Broodlord page says it 'can crit for up to 8,000 on plate', so a normal one is about 4,000, and a guide quotes 3,250 to 6,500 a hit after armor. Both fit a weapon about 0.6 times vmangos's, which the file uses for his melee and every weapon damage ability: 1,648 to 2,184 a swing. Knock Away 18670 weapon damage + 30, Cleave 15284 weapon damage + 10, Blast Wave 23331 2,625 to 3,375 Fire. Timers from the vmangos script, which says they are probably wrong.
notes: His weapon damage is an estimate from what players saw (source), until Warcraft Logs give his white hits and Mortal Strikes. Knock Away's 50% threat cut isn't modelled. Blast Wave hits everyone near him, here the tanks only, and the healing sim adds the melee.

healing.notes: A 40-player Blackwing Lair raid's main tank: 4 healers at 500 HPS each in 2 s heals, more healing power than in Molten Core (about 600). Guessed, not from logs: replace with tools/warcraftlogs tank numbers.
